name: Chroma key
summary: Remove one flat colour from a shot and put another picture behind the subject.
how: Light a flat green or blue ground evenly, with no shadows.
Keep the subject at 1 m or more from the ground to avoid colour spill.
Key out the ground colour and feather the mask edge by 1px to 2px.
Place the new picture behind the subject and match its light direction.

origin.note: Larry Butler makes the blue-screen travelling-matte shots of The Thief of Bagdad.

adoptions.via: TikTok adds a green-screen effect: the creator keeps the face and body and swaps the ground for any photo.
